# ZRP Social

> ZRP Social is the first Swiss-European social media platform, built around free speech, privacy, and security. 35% of platform profits go to charities supporting orphans, schools, hospitals, and climate relief.

## Docs

- [About](https://zrp.one/about): Mission and background of ZRP Social
- [FAQ](https://zrp.one/faq): Frequently asked questions about accounts, posting, messaging, privacy, and plans
- [Help Center](https://zrp.one/help): Guides for using ZRP Social
- [Pricing](https://zrp.one/pricing): Free, Pro, and Business plan details
- [Privacy Policy](https://zrp.one/privacy): How ZRP Social collects, uses, and protects data
- [Terms of Service](https://zrp.one/terms): Terms governing use of the platform

## News

- [ZRP News](https://zrp.one/news): Latest stories from Switzerland, Europe, and around the world

- [Careers](https://zrp.one/careers): Open roles at ZRP Social

- [Contact](https://zrp.one/contact): Get in touch with the ZRP Social team
